response.query:
PREFIX cmt: <http://cmt#>
PREFIX edas: <http://edas#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?conferencechair WHERE { { SERVICE <http://192.168.100.45:3030/cmt/sparql> { ?conferencechair a cmt:ConferenceChair . } } UNION { SERVICE <http://192.168.100.45:3030/edas/sparql> { ?conferencechair a edas:ConferenceChair . } } }
